#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

typedef long long int LL;

const LL MOD = 1000000007LL;

LL qp(LL p,LL x) { 
    LL ans = 1; 
    for(int i=0;i<x;++i) 
        ans = (ans*p)%MOD; 
    return ans; 
}

LL solve(LL p,LL k)
{
    if(k<=1) return qp(p,p-1+k);
    int ord = 1;
    for(LL now=k;now!=1;++ord) 
        now = (now*k)%p;
    return qp(p,(p-1)/ord);
}

int main(void)
{
    LL p,k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    cout << solve(p,k) << endl;
    return 0;
}

    for(int i=0;i<x;++i) 
        ans = ((ans%MOD)*(p%MOD))%MOD;

    return qp(p,(p-1)/ord);
